title: Payouts Desk Rule Note: Cashout Holdback When a Payout Hold Is Lifted
content:
A cashout holdback is kept back from the hold-release payout when a payout hold on a **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** earnings account is lifted. The cashout holdback is the total of the instant cashouts made from the account within the last 1 whole month, before their fees, multiplied by a share that follows how many instant cashouts were made in that period:

- 3 or more instant cashouts set the share at 0.2 (20%);
- at least one but fewer than 3 set it at 0.1 (10%);
- none sets it at zero.

The holdback is taken off the available balance when the hold is lifted, together with anything else kept back from that payout in one deduction and before the payout is rounded; what is kept back stays in the available balance and is paid with the next scheduled weekly payout.

## Input, judgement, output

| Input read from the earnings statement | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Number of instant cashouts in the last 1 whole month | 0, 1 to 2, or 3 or more | Share of 0, 0.1 or 0.2 |
| Amounts of those instant cashouts, before their fees | Added together | Cashout total |
| Cashout total and share | Multiplied | Cashout holdback |

## Worked cases (hypothetical statements)

| Instant cashouts in the last 1 whole month (amounts, before fees) | Count | Share | Cashout holdback |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| 120.00 | 1 | 0.1 | 12.00 |
| 120.00 and 80.00 | 2 | 0.1 | 20.00 |
| 100.00, 150.00 and 50.00 | 3 | 0.2 | 60.00 |

The cashout fees booked with those cashouts are not part of the total: a 100.00 cashout that carried a 0.85 fee counts as 100.00.
